description:
Evening Wind Down | Sitar Instrumental | 1.5 Hours of calm Indian music to end the day gently

The work is done, or done enough. What's left is the evening — and how you spend the first hour of it decides how you sleep.

This peaceful Indian ambient music holds a soft, warm calm for 90 minutes, so the day can drain out of your shoulders on its own.

You'll hear a warm, unhurried sitar — long singing slides and gentle ornaments over a low tanpura drone. No percussion, no build-ups, nothing to follow.

Perfect for winding down after work, a cozy evening in, dinner and dim lights, reading, unwinding with tea, or filling the room with calm while you do nothing at all.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Sitar
Raga: Bhupali — a gentle five-note evening raga, warm and open
Style: Indian classical ambient, instrumental only
Mood: Warm, soft, settled
Duration: 1.5 hours

🎧 HOW TO USE
Put it on when you close the laptop and let it run through the evening. Room speaker at low volume is ideal — this is music for the space, not the headphones.

⏱ CHAPTERS

⏱ BEST FOR
